tools.description: Use this when the user wants current AIApply job listings filtered by role, skills, remote status, or country. Works without an AIApply account: the role is then required, since there is no saved keyword to fall back on. For a signed-in user, omitting the role uses only the account’s basic job-searc

tools.name: list_review_jobs
tools.description: Use this when the connected user wants applications currently waiting for review. Return only job facts and opaque IDs; never submit or change an application. Needs an AIApply account: if the user has not signed in, calling it asks them to sign in or create one.

tools.name: list_applications
tools.description: Use this when the connected user wants recent AIApply application and preparation status. Return role, company, status, match score, timestamp, and canonical listing link without exposing resumes or contact details. Needs an AIApply account: if the user has not signed in, calling it asks them to sig

tools.description: Use this when the connected user asks what AIApply prepared for one specific application, identified by the job_id returned from list_applications or list_review_jobs. tools.description: Use this when the connected user asks about current AIApply job preferences or before suggesting a change. Read target roles, locations, work types, experience, salary, exclusions, daily limit, and application mode without modifying them. Nothing here can change them: to change one, call open_auto_a

tools.name: open_auto_apply_preferences
tools.description: Use this when the connected user asks to change their AIApply job preferences — target roles, locations, work types, experience, salary, excluded companies, the daily limit, or how applications are submitted. Nothing here can change them: this returns the link to the page where the user changes them

tools.name: list_unread_mail
tools.description: Use this when the connected user asks whether anything new has arrived in their AIApply mailbox, or before telling them about interview invites. Returns unread messages as sender and subject only, with a link to the mailbox. It cannot open a message, and reading this list does not mark anything as s

tools.description: Use this when the connected user wants AIApply to apply to a job they picked from search_jobs. AIApply adds it to their queue already approved, so it does not wait for anyone: it will be applied for and that spends a credit. This is the only point the user is asked, so call it without confirmed, sho

tools.description: Use this only when the connected user has asked for one specific job from their review queue to be applied for, identified by the job_id from list_review_jobs. tools.description: Use this when the connected user asks to stop or restart AIApply applying for them. action="pause" stops all automatic applying and is destructive: call it without confirmed, show the user what will stop, ask them, then call again with confirmed=true. action="resume" restarts applying and spends cre

tools.description: Use this before queuing or sending work to check the connected user can still pay for it, or when they ask how many applications they have left. Reports the credit balance, whether auto-apply is active, the plan slug and the configured daily cap. The balance is what remains; the daily cap is not — n

tools.description: Use this when the connected user wants AIApply to apply for them, and again whenever they come back to it: it says what is still missing — their resume, their confirmed job preferences, or applying being active on the account — and next_step names the one thing to do now. tools.name: add_resume
tools.description: Use this when get_setup_status says next_step is add_resume. Pass exactly one of: resume, the file the user attached, if you can attach files to tool calls; or resume_text, the content of their CV as you can read it, or the work history, education and skills the user tells you. Never invent or embel

tools.name: save_auto_apply_setup
tools.description: Use this once the user has seen and confirmed the job titles, location, work mode, job type and experience level AIApply needs: call it with confirmed=true and the values they confirmed, without asking them again. Without confirmed it only checks the values and saves nothing. Only for a first setup

findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: list_review_jobs, list_unread_mail, submit_application, get_setup_status · Private data: list_applications, preview_application, add_resume · Public sink: list_review_jobs, submit_application, get_credits_summary.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: list_review_jobs, list_unread_mail, submit_application, get_setup_status · Private data: list_applications, preview_application, add_resume · Public sink: list_review_jobs, submit_application, get_credits_summary

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
